commit_message: Integrate ADR0135 with remote AI Studio
pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ADR0135 native inference resource arbitration
pr_body:
## Summary

Integrates ADR0135 native inference scheduling and Editor GPU resource arbitration on current main after ADR0133 Remote AI Studio landed. Preserves the same authoritative Agent Host, remote idempotency, loopback MCP boundary, and Stop cancellation semantics while adding workload/quality/resource planning, InferenceFocused presentation reclaim/restore, backend capability reporting, native inference interruption, and resumable manual-edit control state.
